annotations.title: Dry-run (or run now) a Meta automated rule

description: DRY RUN BY DEFAULT: Meta's own preview of which campaigns / ad sets / ads pass the rule right now, with names and budgets — nothing changes. Use it before switching a rule on, and to sanity-check money units. dryRun:false asks Meta to RUN it now (Meta runs a switched-off rule by hand too), so it takes the same gate as switching on; the run is asynchronous, read it with meta_ad_rule_history. Schedule rules only. Free.

adAccountId.description: Meta ad account id (act_… or the bare number) from list_meta_ads; required — every rule lives on one ad account

confirm.description: true once the user has said yes to exactly what the refusal described

confirmScope.description: the scopeToken the list tool (or the refusal) prints; required with confirm when the rule can raise spend

dryRun.description: default true; false runs it for real
